freeze_timing_integrity.purpose: reduce researcher degrees of freedom by freezing the conditional Stage-1 mechanism before observing Stage-0 utility

development_protocol.fit_boundary: for each held development fold, residual fitting and model selection use only its frozen VALID role; its TEST role is evaluated once
development_protocol.inner_validation: deterministic grouped inner folds on VALID, grouping jointly by target_homology_cluster and scaffold_group

base_offset.name: FROZEN_QUERY_BALANCED_NONSTRUCTURAL_FLOOR
base_offset.why_this_base: EQIR must add value beyond the strongest frozen nonnovel S3 development floor rather than inherit an easier BioMaster-only reference

equals_one_only_if_all: target is in the effective label-blind structure manifest
strict experimental receptor route is used
receptor identifier and receptor file hash match the frozen job
all GNINA controls for the target completed without extraction failure
the target-local candidate set contains at least 16 molecules
equals_zero_if_any: experimental structure or qualified pocket is absent
GNINA job or score extraction is incomplete
target is one of the 46 recovered only because no experimental pocket existed
forbidden: Gate A or Gate B derived from evaluation-fold activity labels
learning qualification parameters from pair labels

structure_increment_inputs.normalization: target-local empirical CDF or robust quantile fitted without interaction labels; raw docking scores are never compared across targets
structure_increment_inputs.missing_value_policy: qualification becomes zero; no zero-filled learned structure vector is passed to the residual head
prohibited_features: current-fold Gate A or Gate B

head.normalization: LayerNorm after each hidden affine layer

residual_mechanism.exact_fallback_invariant: a(t)=0 implies s(d,t) and b(d,t) are bitwise identical before sigmoid
residual_mechanism.increment_interpretation: the structure head is trained only to explain the cross-fitted nonstructural prediction residual; it is not permitted to relearn the complete label from sequence, molecule, or target identity

training_objective.residual_loss: Huber(u(d,t), a(t)*r_theta(d,t), delta=0.25) on qualified VALID pairs
training_objective.query_pair_sampling: equal numbers of evaluable target-query and drug-query positive-negative pairs per optimizer step; deterministic seed-specific sampling
training_objective.selection_objective: equal-weight mean of inner-validation micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC, and drug-macro AUPRC
selection_constraints: inner-validation drug-macro must not be below the frozen base
inner-validation target-macro may be at most 0.002 below the frozen base
ties within 1e-6 choose the lower-capacity and lower-learning-rate candidate

mandatory_audits.five_seed_directional_consistency: at least 4 of 5 seeds have positive held-test micro AUPRC difference versus every required same-data reference
mandatory_audits.drug_query_pair_signal: full EQIR drug-macro AUPRC exceeds the within-drug score-permutation 95% upper bound
mandatory_audits.qualification_independence: recompute a(t) using only frozen QC artifacts and verify no label-derived column is read
